subject: Seen from above at a low angle: a few small pale bones marked with black charcoal lines, scattered where they were thrown on a square of pale tan rawhide on dark forest ground, beside the embers of a small campfire; night, warm firelight, ferns and leaf litter. No people, no hands.
credits: see account (2392 before both Prompt 36 images)
verdict: one sample, 1K: bones thrown on a hide in a night forest beside a stone-ringed fire, no prints in the ground, no people; the charcoal marks are faint. Shared by the four omen cards (hw_event_omen_raids, _eagle, _bear, _quiet).
